import copy
import sys

expected = [rows[1], rows[3], rows[5]]

    collected = []

        result = list_active(rows, page, size)

        assert len(result) == len(wanted)
        assert all(a is b for a, b in zip(result, wanted))
        collected.extend(result)
        checks += 1
